about: One row per input of the local-target design's acceptance list, for every origin. 'owner' is what the one owner (crates/tine-core/src/local_target.rs) answers; 'today' is what the separate answerers do before they ask the owner: the renderer (rendered and clicked, desktop, graph root 'root'), the asset collector and export, which all still answer this way. Liveness (orphans and trash) keeps 'today.collector' plus the owner's attachment alive: never fewer names than 'today'. 'change' names the decision or rule behind each place the owner differs from today; null means the same answer. Tests: src/render/localTarget.table.test.tsx, crates/tine-core/src/local_target_tests.rs, crates/tine-graph-features/src/publish_query_table_tests.rs.
